Reviewer: wopr pool job review-4191 (task ID; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is unset), GPT-6 (Codex), mkinney/Codex; did not write or refresh this PR.

Code review clean on the tested base. The PR now conflicts with current main. Label: `conflicts`.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. I read the whole diff and the linked issue. No earlier review or finding exists.

The raster keeps the existing cut samples and plans its links again after ordering. The command and generator refuse unsupported patterns. The finished path checks the picked corners after the rings and area controls. The new tests check the exact ball-column clearance, path equivalence, MCP edits, undo and redo.

### Local results

All commands ran locally, in the foreground, in `.claude/worktrees/review-4191`. No GitHub runner was used.

Tested PR head: `61d5b61ed996039ede5d475a85af5ce1cee2be0d`.
Tested upstream main: `e6849c5aea183b81135c8143955cc8c88a429a89`.
Local trial merge: `010190e98d597bf936bf32ec8bd3d683a88886c7`. Its first parent is the PR head. The tested base was already an ancestor of the PR.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 217 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 31.7 minutes. Test totals: 2,655 passed, 103 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 11 tests passed.
- Pinning tests passed: motion `finishing3d::finish_seam_tests` (2), `multiaxis::finish_seam` (5), and app `start_exit_shared::finish3d` (3).
- Full suites passed: motion lib (725 passed, 22 ignored), motion `multiaxis` (22 passed), and app `start_exit_shared` (43 passed).

### Extra suites run

These suites ran by name in the quick gate:

- App `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 4 ignored.
- App `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- App `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- App `golden_cl`: 34 passed.

No fixture directory, importer, UI file, dependency, build script, or workflow changed. The extra fixture and kernel suite rules do not apply. Full heavy lanes were not run, as permitted by current upstream AGENTS.md. No golden or recorded program moved; the body lists none.

### Mutations repeated locally

Each mutation ran alone. Each test failed under the mutation and passed after source restoration.

1. M1: remove `raster_ends_kept` after the waterline rings. `finish_seam::finish_with_waterlines_keeps_a_start_and_refuses_an_exit_by_name` failed (0 passed, 1 failed). Restored: 1 passed.
2. M3: bypass the rejection in `ends_clear`. Both `finishing3d::finish_seam_tests` failed (0 passed, 2 failed). Restored: 2 passed.

The mutation source was restored byte for byte. The worktree is clean. No evidence was committed.

### Merge conflicts

Upstream main changed during the local gates. Its current head is `72890060b53a6dc836e8cee1d928226e11a4d753`. GitHub reports `CONFLICTING`. A local `git merge-tree` check confirms conflicts in:

- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs:402`: the MCP descriptions for the Deburr and 3D Finish picks overlap.
- `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs:102`: the two slices change the capability match arms.
- `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs:198`: the two slices add test modules at the same location.

These locations refer to the PR head. A merge-time refresh must keep both slices and their tests. The refreshed head needs verification. The results above cover the stated tested base, not the newer conflicting main.

No code blocker was found. I leave the review worktree and branch in place to keep the build warm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Refreshed for merge: merged main 498382c8e; conflict in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`, `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs` and `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs` resolved by hand (each hunk keeps the two sides: main's Deburr `PickCapability::Chain` (#3329 slice 1) and this PR's 3D Finish `PickCapability::Raster` (slice 2); the `edit_operation` schema keeps the 3D Finish limit text and adds main's chain clause; the two kinds are removed from the no-pick list); `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test start_exit_shared` (46 pass, `finish3d` and `deburr` included) and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` pass.

@qsmits: The new head is 0016e1647. The merge needed hand edits in three files. Thus the clean review of the earlier head 61d5b61ed does not stay valid without a check. The new head waits for a delta review of the remerge-diff. You do not have to do work for this.

Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4191, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), mkinney (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=~/.claude-team-skull); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: clean. Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Label: `merge-ready` (GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`). The `conflicts` label is removed.

This is a SAFETY-tier delta review. The PR changes toolpath generation (the order of the 3D Finish raster) and adds gouge refusals. The new head `0016e164` is a merge of main `498382c8e` with hand edits (class DELTA). The earlier review of head `61d5b61e` was clean and had no findings.

### Earlier findings

The earlier review (https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4191#issuecomment-7198213170) had no findings. It said only that the PR conflicted with main and that the refreshed head needs a check. That check is this review.

### Delta review (remerge-diff of `0016e164`)

I read `git show --remerge-diff 0016e164`. The three conflict hunks keep the two sides:

- `crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs`: `OpType::Finish3D => PickCapability::Raster` (this PR) and `OpType::Deburr => PickCapability::Chain` (main, #4168). The two kinds are removed from the no-pick list. Each kind has exactly one arm.
- `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs`: the `raster` list keeps the 3D Finish limit text. The `chain` list and its clause from main stay. The `format!` has four `{}` and four arguments.
- `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared.rs`: the capability test expects `Raster` for the 3D Finish and `Chain` for the Deburr. The two modules `finish3d` and `deburr` are both declared.

No safety rule is lost. The generator code, the door refusal and the `raster_ends_kept` checks are the same as on the reviewed head.

### Local results

All commands ran locally on this host, in the foreground, in `.claude/worktrees/review-4191`. No GitHub runner was used.

- PR head: `0016e1647ea9df99820d11d7c216b9c6c70a8287`.
- Upstream main: `d94c65fcfb9810036bfbe86bd18467b9d20f64a9`.
- Local trial merge: clean (no conflict). Its first parent is the PR head.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (217 steps, run in 7 parts with `--only`) | 216 ok, 1 failed (pre-existing, see below) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed |
| Pinning: `camcraft-motion --lib finishing3d::finish_seam_tests` | 2 passed |
| Pinning: `camcraft-motion --test multiaxis finish_seam` | 5 passed |
| Pinning: `camcraft-app --test start_exit_shared` (full suite) | 46 passed (`finish3d` and `deburr` included) |

**Pre-existing failure, not a blocker:** `motion suites: finish3d_hop_height` fails 3 of 5 tests (`a_retract_above_the_part_hops_clean`, `a_retract_below_the_high_run_never_takes_the_tool_into_the_part`, `inside_first_on_a_convex_part_with_a_low_retract_never_digs_in`). The verifier finds `RapidInPart`. I ran the same suite on bare upstream/main `d94c65f`. It fails in the same 3 tests at the same lines. Issue #4211 (`main is red (post-merge gate)`) tracks it. This PR does not touch that suite or the verifier.

### Extra suites run

These suites ran by name in the quick gate. All passed:

- App `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`.
- App `golden_cl`.
- App `finish3d_direction`, `finish3d_pass_start`, `finish3d_hop_height`, `do_not_touch_finish3d`.

The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no fixture directory and no importer. The fixture and kernel suite rules do not apply. No heavy lane ran: the PR is `P2`, and current upstream AGENTS.md ("Heavy lanes at review") gives no heavy step to a `P2` PR.

### Mutations repeated locally

I chose two mutations that the earlier review did not run. Each ran alone. The source was restored, and `git status` was clean after each.

1. M4: the door refusal of another pattern is off (`pick_kinds.rs`, the `Finish3D` pattern check). Red: `finish3d::finish3d_picks_ride_edit_operation_and_another_pattern_is_refused_at_the_door` (panic at `finish3d.rs:184`). Restored: green.
2. M2: the post-clip `raster_ends_kept` check is off (`generate.rs`). Red: `finish3d::finish3d_refuses_an_impossible_pick_by_name` (panic at `finish3d.rs:163`). Restored: green.

### Goldens moved

None. No recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`), golden or snapshot PNG changed. This agrees with the body.

### Law check

- No new `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in non-test code.
- `finish_seam.rs` has its provenance lines. It has 179 lines.
- The new tests join the existing directory suites `start_exit_shared/` and `multiaxis/`. No new top-level test binary.
- No new dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/`, `.github/` or process file change.
- The body has `Changelog:`, the decision file and `Refs #3329` (a partial slice; #3329 stays open for the 3D Pocket).
- No UI file changed, so no screenshots are necessary.

### Optional, non-blocking

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is 4,904 lines. It was far over 400 lines before this PR. This PR adds 22 lines. A split along the operation seams is a separate task.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
